actual_review: Root opened actual saved four-view PNG. Front/rear/side/quarter show the same two rear uprights, tan upper rear tie, single continuous low tan deck and grounded connected petrol base. No front post, side rail, cargo or separate small pallet obstructs the interior. Quarter shows real depth; side correctly occludes the far rear post. The visible front/rear base feet are construction styling, not extra bins. Exact L091.6x.85x1.2 outer, .18 support/.04deck, two .10m rear-post envelopes and1.4x.6x1.0 usable override illustrative spacing/bevels. Matte colours and stepped collars retain R02 language. Model support, fit, physical load rating and actual operational admission remain separate downstream gates.
